headline: The Ark becomes industry — four plates, parallel city yards
lede: CIVILIZATION V's science victory stopped being a beaker faucet: after Spaceflight each of the four Ark plates (Cockpit, Booster, Stasis, Launch) is a city production project — one at a time per yard, any order, cities welding in parallel on their own shields. 626 contract checks, a mutant that reddens 19 gates when a delivery is dropped, live on jalfern.com.

notes.text: CivV Ark yards (c0720bc, #2077): per-city ARK_<id> queue kind, delivery sets the realm's plate bits, victory needs all four bits AND the ledger gate; the AI and witness mobilise identically (oldest missing plate, rotation spread) so replays stay honest.
SHORT ORDER SHOUT radio law (4f16b26, #2082): the cook is tied while the radio keys — A/B refused during keying/draining, and the CPU line answers landed takes.

Prod-marker scans must use user-facing literals: DEV-only DebugKit strings tree-shake out of the shipped bundle, and game chunks are hashed index-*.js — harvest the asset list from the entry bundle and scan all ~61 chunks in Node.
Vite can listen IPv6-only: a 127.0.0.1 probe says 'no dev server' while [::1]:5173 is alive. lsof the listener's cwd before restarting a strictPort server — use localhost for harness URLs.
